evidence: Both import cycles are gone (cycles detector reports no open issues).
GPUtil was removed from pyproject and from all GPU discovery paths; nvidia-smi and rocm-smi are the only backends.
The dependency set is focused: httpx, pydantic-settings, FastAPI/uvicorn, Typer/Rich, structlog, numpy, psutil.
No duplicate HTTP client or settings framework was found.
requirements.txt now mirrors pyproject and no longer lists GPUtil; the dependency lists cannot drift silently.
dependency_health.issues_preventing_higher_score: GPUtil and both import cycles are gone, and requirements.txt is aligned with pyproject. A focused dependency set with no known maintenance hazards supports a strong score.

evidence: All 62 API routes still have no authentication; this is now documented as a localhost-only threat model in README.
web_main refuses a non-loopback bind unless LM_OPTIMIZER_ALLOW_REMOTE=1, making remote exposure a deliberate opt-in.
Apply, restore, save-default and save-ollama-default routes now emit structured config_change audit events.
The default bind is 127.0.0.1 and CORS is restricted to localhost origins.
Remote bind now requires LM_OPTIMIZER_API_TOKEN; non-loopback mutating requests must send X-API-Token, with tests covering refusal and acceptance.
authorization_consistency.issues_preventing_higher_score: Localhost-only default, a startup guard, audit events and a token for remote mutating requests address the practical risk for this local tool. A full user/permission model remains the next step.

evidence: The only real service-layer print() calls (deepresearch.py) were replaced with a formatting function rendered by the CLI.
Defensive overengineering remains: 152 silent broad catches, concentrated in optimizer.py (41), routes.py (30) and cli/main.py (14).
Comment ratio is 2.5%, so restating comments are not the main issue.
Some long functions still carry docstrings that describe only one of several responsibilities.
128 silent except/pass blocks now log through best_effort.log_best_effort with exc_info.
save_best_report and _test_config docstrings now list their side effects and outputs.
ai_generated_debt.issues_preventing_higher_score: Silent catches are logged, service print output is gone, and the remaining long-function docstrings now describe their side effects. Comments stay sparse and why-focused.

dependency_health.dimension_character: Dependencies now have clear roles and the two maintenance hazards (unmaintained GPUtil and import cycles) are gone. The declared set is small, though the legacy requirements.txt has drifted from pyproject.
dependency_health.score_rationale: GPUtil and both import cycles are gone, and requirements.txt is aligned with pyproject. A focused dependency set with no known maintenance hazards supports a strong score.

authorization_consistency.dimension_character: Authorization is still absent by design for a local tool, but the trust boundary is now explicit and enforced at startup, and state-changing operations leave an audit trail.
authorization_consistency.score_rationale: Localhost-only default, a startup guard, audit events and a token for remote mutating requests address the practical risk for this local tool. A full user/permission model remains the next step.

ai_generated_debt.dimension_character: The code reads as purposeful rather than generated: comments are sparse, service print output is gone and tolerated failures are now visible at debug level.
ai_generated_debt.score_rationale: Silent catches are logged, service print output is gone, and the remaining long-function docstrings now describe their side effects. Comments stay sparse and why-focused.

issues.summary: No lock file pins transitive dependency versions
issues.suggestion: Add a lock file (uv.lock or pip-compile output) for reproducible installs and CI.
evidence: Both files use lower bounds (>=) and there is no lock file in the repository.
A fresh install can resolve different transitive versions over time.

issues.summary: Loopback routes remain unauthenticated by design
issues.suggestion: If the tool ships as a multi-user service, add a user/session model rather than extending the loopback bypass.
evidence: Local loopback traffic bypasses the token guard so the UI keeps working.
This is documented as a localhost-only threat model.

issues.summary: API handlers still catch broad exceptions and build ad-hoc 500 responses
issues.suggestion: Move exception-to-HTTP translation into one middleware or exception handler and keep handler bodies focused on the domain call.
evidence: Several handlers catch Exception and raise HTTPException(500, detail=str(e)) inline.
The pattern is defensive boilerplate rather than one mapped error boundary.

add.description: One HTTP client (httpx), one settings stack (pydantic-settings) and one CLI/UI stack (Typer/Rich + FastAPI) avoid duplicate-purpose libraries.
The web UI binds 127.0.0.1 by default and CORS allows only localhost origins, reducing accidental network exposure.
The 2.5% comment ratio and short docstrings avoid restating code; comments generally explain constraints or intent.
